definitions.explanation: The act of restraining oneself from rash or inappropriate actions; exercising caution and discretion in one's behavior.

examples.japanese: {自重|じちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧
⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自重|じちょう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please exercise restraint in your remarks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自重|じちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The government called on citizens to refrain from going out.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {自重|じちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exercise self-restraint).

HOMOPHONE: Different from {自重|じじゅう} (one's own weight), which is read differently.

NUANCE: {自重|じちょう} implies voluntary self-control, often used in formal or official contexts when asking people to moderate their behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自重|じちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exercise self-restraint)
- {自重|じちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to call for self-restraint)
- {自重|じちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧ (to urge self-restraint)
- ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自重|じちょう} (restraint in remarks)

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ (to refrain from, hold back)
- ⟦{自粛|じしゅく}→自粛：07650_jishuku⟧ (voluntary restraint)
